process.headline: OUR ENGINEERED PROJECT PROCESS
process.description: Every project follows a structured workflow designed to reduce risk, improve coordination, and deliver predictable results.

steps.title: Project Analysis
steps.description: We review site conditions, climate factors, architectural expectations, structure type, budget, and project timeline.

steps.title: Engineering Design
steps.description: We prepare shop drawings, panel layout, cutting list, slope design, gutter and downspout plans, flashing details, and material lists.

steps.title: Procurement Control
steps.description: We evaluate suppliers, confirm technical specifications, approve samples, coordinate production, and control packaging and delivery.

steps.title: Installation
steps.description: We manage storage, substructure checks, gutter installation, panel overlaps, fastening standards, flashing, sealing, and site safety.

steps.title: Testing & Delivery
steps.description: We inspect alignment, fastening, sealing, drainage, foam continuity, and waterproofing before final project handover.

questions.question: How can sandwich panel roof leakage be prevented?
questions.answer: Proper drainage design, flashing details, overlap control, sealing systems, and correct installation sequencing help prevent leakage.

questions.question: What roof slope is recommended for sandwich panels?
questions.answer: The required slope depends on panel type, climate conditions, drainage length, and waterproofing strategy.

questions.question: Why are shop drawings important in industrial roofing?
questions.answer: Shop drawings coordinate panel layout, drainage, flashing, overlaps, fastening, and material takeoff before installation begins.

questions.question: How does Sipanel reduce project risk?
questions.answer: Sipanel uses engineering planning, material optimization, and controlled installation workflows before execution starts.

questions.question: Which sandwich panel core is best for cold storage?
questions.answer: The correct core depends on insulation requirements, temperature range, fire performance, and project budget.

questions.question: How is thermal leakage reduced in cold storage projects?
questions.answer: Thermal continuity, sealing quality, joint detailing, and correct panel installation help reduce thermal leakage.

questions.question: Why is airtightness important in cold storage buildings?
questions.answer: Poor airtightness increases energy consumption, condensation risk, and temperature instability.

questions.question: What is included in sandwich panel shop drawings?
questions.answer: Shop drawings include panel layout, flashing details, drainage systems, overlaps, fastening, cutting lists, and material takeoff.

questions.question: How do shop drawings reduce project cost?
questions.answer: Accurate planning reduces material waste, installation errors, delays, and unnecessary procurement.

questions.question: Why should shop drawings be completed before procurement?
questions.answer: Engineering coordination before purchasing helps avoid incorrect ordering, redesign, and execution conflicts.
